definitions.explanation: The act of going ahead to show the way or taking the lead in guiding a group or initiative.

examples.japanese: ⟦パレード→パレード：11293_pareedo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{先導|せんどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{先導|せんどう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: A police vehicle led the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先導|せんどう}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}め→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: She served as the project leader and brought the whole team together.

notes:
A compound of {先|せん} (ahead/first) and {導|どう} (guide/lead). Implies physically or figuratively going ahead to show the way for others to follow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先導|せんどう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lead, to guide
- {先導|せんどう}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: leader, guide (role)
- {先導|せんどう}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: lead vehicle, escort car
- {先導|せんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: under the guidance of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧: guidance — more everyday; implies showing around or giving directions
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: instruction, coaching — implies teaching or supervising rather than going ahead
- ⟦{誘導|ゆうどう}→誘導：16951_yuudou⟧: guidance, leading — implies directing or channeling movement, often in a controlled manner
- ⟦{船頭|せんどう}→船頭：13986_sendou⟧: boatman — a homophone with an unrelated meaning
